claim: Eight fixed 60-second laps end with a result and build string.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo?test=1; choose one modifier after each accelerated lap; assert the eighth-lap result

claim: The sample run is separate and does not save real progress or settings.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; preload real settings, change demo settings, and assert only demo-prefixed session keys are read or written

claim: Keyboard and touch controls both move the paddle.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /play; move right by keyboard and left by the on-screen touch control

claim: Run progress and settings persist in this browser.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /play; wait for save, change a setting, reload, and assert both local records

claim: A completed real run saves its best result in this browser.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /play?test=1; finish the real eight-lap run, assert the stored score and build, reload, and assert the record is unchanged

claim: The game maintains 60 fps on a mid-range phone, measured at 390px in the browser test.
sandbox: fresh 390px browser context at /demo; record 180 requestAnimationFrame intervals and assert 14–18 ms mean with p95 at or below 22 ms

claim: The game has no account, ads, analytics, or personal-data requests.
sandbox: record every request during a fresh demo flow and assert that every origin is the product origin

claim: The game reloads offline after the first visit.
sandbox: new browser context at /demo; wait for service worker, reload online once, set context offline, then reload and assert the game heading
